# Unregistered HyperCam 2

Add the funny watermark from the unregistered version of the HyperCam 2 screen recorder to your game!

**HyperCam is a trademark of Hyperionics Technology LLC. This mod is not affiliated with or endorsed by Hyperionics Technology LLC.**
changelog:
# Changelogs
## v1.0.4
- Update Geode to v5.4.1
- Add an "Enabled" setting to the mod settings for a master toggle

## v1.0.3
- Geode v5.0.0-beta.1 support

## v1.0.2
- 2.208 support (Geode v5)
- Added 3 options: In Everywhere, In Gameplay and In Editor
- Rewrote the entire mod

## v1.0.1
Technical change, nothing interesting for the end user. 
For developers: added the sprite to UILayer.

## v1.0.0
Initial release
